limitations.description: The SDT real test partition was accessed during A-stage geometry and semantic development and remains REAL_EVAL_DEVELOPMENT only.
Subject, session, recording, sequence, event, timestamp/FPS, scene and camera identifiers are not sufficiently distributed.
LYING -> HUMAN_FALL is a derived frame-level posture proxy and cannot support temporal fall-event or safety claims.
T-A6 measured 14,514 TRAIN-VALIDATION near-duplicate pairs under a deterministic non-exhaustive screen.
The compact bundle has counts and truncated witnesses but not the complete implicated VALIDATION index set.
The deployed reference performs per-frame min-max normalization while T-A6 canonical data is Celsius float32.
Thermal-44 packet, orientation, invalid-pixel, hardware latency and domain-equivalence facts remain unknown.
Commercial use, raw redistribution and public model-artifact release are not cleared by T-B0.
